verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs describe automatic tax calculation/filing and tax-compliance handling (gusto-docs-44, gusto-docs-45, gusto-docs-56) implying year-end tax form generation, but no docs explicitly detail automated W-2/1099 generation and distribution workflow. Concrete community evidence shows this capability failing in practice — a W-2c reissue error combined payments from two tax IDs causing duplicate IRS reporting, with support unresponsive for over a week (gusto-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of W-2/1099 generation and distribution steps, evidence of successful year-end runs, and resolution/track record data to counterbalance the failure report.
